## Goal

First real end-to-end use of the full pipeline: Watchlist → Protocol → Scoring Strategy → Automation → MT5 trading.

## Context
dxy-regime directive now detects USD strength effects on gold, forex, commodities, crypto. Need a dedicated protocol optimized for DXY-sensitive symbols.

## Protocol: dxy-sensitivity-v1
- Technical (40%): speed-momentum, bollinger-squeeze, volume-confirmation, rsi-oversold, support-resistance, session-timing-filter
- Sentiment (20%): news-sentiment
- Risk (40%): dxy-regime, volatility-regime, liquidity-check, position-concentration, correlation-drag
- Symbols: XAUUSD, XAGUSD, EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, NZDUSD, USDCAD, USDJPY, USDCHF, BTCUSD
- Timeframe: 5s-30s tick scalp

## DXY Data
- Preferred: MT5 DX/DXY symbol (zero rate limit)
- Fallback: Finnhub forex EURUSD as proxy (60 calls/min)

## Acceptance
1. All 10 symbols available in MT5
2. DXY data source wired
3. Protocol scores all symbols via SpeedScan
4. DXY Sensitive watchlist created
5. Scoring strategy pairs protocol + watchlist
6. Automation loop runs strategy
7. Manual test: 1 MT5 trade from top signal
8. Log: score → decision → execution → PnL
